newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU Commission to re-examine molasses balance sheet.
newsitem.headline: EU Commission to re-examine molasses balance sheet.

text.p: The European Commission is to review the 1996/97 molasses statistics because they show inconsistencies, the European Union sugar management committee heard on Wednesday, an EU official said on Thursday.
"The figures supplied by member states were raised at the sugar management committee on Wednesday but were said by the Commission to contain inconsistencies which need correcting," the official said.
A Commission official said that the figures could not be released.
"The figures contain inconsistencies and they will be reviewed with representatives of the industry at Monday's meeting of the sugar advisory committee," the official said.
The sugar advisory committee, which normally meets in March, is meeting early because of urgent budgetary issues, the official added.
